title: Punctured Kummer charts with a prescribed principal divisor equation
statement: Let $i:U\to L$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ a finite group and $W\to U$ a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $R$ be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R\to L$ a morphism, and $f\in R$ a nonzerodivisor with regular quotient $R/(f)$. Assume $|G|$ is invertible in $R$. Suppose $\beta:U\times_L\operatorname{Spec}R\simeq D(f)$ [def-pc-fibre-product] satisfies $\beta;\iota_{D(f)}=\operatorname{pr}_2$. For every $y\in\operatorname{Spec}R$ with $f\in\mathfrak p_y$ there exist a commutative ring $S$, an etale map $\psi:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $z$ with $\psi(z)=y$. Put $g=\psi^\#(f)$. There exist $m\ge0$ and positive integers $e_k$, each invertible in $S$, indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}m$, such that $S$ and $S/(g)$ are regular and multiplication by $g$ on $S$ is injective. Put $B=\prod_k S[T]/(T^{e_k}-g)$, $N=\operatorname{Spec}B$, $q:N\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ the structural morphism, and $V=D(\operatorname{algebraMap}_{S,B}(g))$. There is an isomorphism $\gamma:W\times_L\operatorname{Spec}S\simeq V$ satisfying $\gamma;\iota_V;q=\operatorname{pr}_2$, where the maps to $L$ are the torsor projection followed by $i$ and $\psi;\varphi$. All rings and schemes are in one universe and $G$ in its successor; empty products are permitted.

proof.text: Apply regular_divisor_root_splitting to the original torsor. It supplies a pointed affine etale neighborhood with the image g of f and a punctured n-th root cover splitting the torsor.
Factor the pulled-back torsor projection through D(g) using beta and the open immersion lifting property. Transport f in y to g in z.

Apply root_split_cover_prescribed_cyclic_charts to the displayed root splitting. Compose the two pointed etale neighborhoods and paste the pullbacks. Use full faithfulness of Spec to identify the prescribed equation with the image of f under the composite.

theorem GaloisCover.regular_divisor_prescribed_punctured_root_chart
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (y : Spec R) (hy : f ∈ y.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (ψ : Spec S ⟶ Spec R) (z : Spec S),
      Etale ψ ∧ ψ z = y ∧
      let g := (Spec.preimage ψ).hom f
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : S)) ∧
        IsRegularRing S ∧ IsSMulRegular S g ∧
        IsRegularRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C g)))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C g))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C g)) g)
        ∃ γ : pullback (W.π ≫ i) (ψ ≫ φ) ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (ψ ≫ φ)
